frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/documents/components/DocumentSharePanel.tsx:275-385 - the SAME feature hardcodes toast strings in ENGLISH ('Copy failed', 'Could not copy to clipboard.', 'Revoke failed', 'Share created', 'Public link copied.', `Link: ${shareUrl}`). So the documents feature mixes two hardcoded languages across its toasts.

Asymmetry confirming this is an accidental gap, not a deliberate opt-out: the sibling file documents/components/MoveFolderDialog.tsx (same feature) DOES use useTranslation()/t() throughout (import at :20, const {t}=useTranslation() at :143 and :295). The toast hooks and DocumentSharePanel were simply not wired to i18n.

Severity LOW (+1), i18n gap: ppt-web is a react-i18next app; these user-facing move/download/share toasts render in a fixed language (Slovak in the hooks, English in the share panel) for every locale. Confidence medium - the hardcoded literals and the absence of t() are confirmed by static read; whether any non-matching locale is actively configured is runtime/config-dependent. Not covered by any existing backlog row (the tracked toast-i18n rows are workflow-automation and route-group action toasts, not the documents feature).
